verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron provides native Postgres cron-syntax scheduling of recurring jobs with monitoring of runs, and Supabase Queues offers a durable message queue for building recurring/async workflows; both are exposed to AI agents via the discoverable agent-skills catalog covering Cron and Queues, and the MCP server lets agents manage these programmatically. Missing for 10: no hands-on/independent evidence of an AI agent actually creating a scheduled cron job end-to-end, and no explicit workflow-orchestration layer beyond cron+queues.
